items.title: White Wash
items.goal: An elegant white satin sheet reveals the ship while five fixture families retain distinct lighting jobs.

intent.concept: An elegant white satin sheet reveals the ship while five fixture families retain distinct lighting jobs.
intent.design_intent: Replace the equal whole-rig wash with a complete but authored white composition: broad Hull material, protected contour, pearl-like Jewelry, discrete Organ punctuation, and calm Identity engraving.
intent.why_exists: It is the white family's versatile bread-and-butter look and practical work-light endpoint without surrendering fixture hierarchy.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: The ship should read immediately from distance as a luminous white vessel, while the rail Jewelry is visibly finer and brighter than the Hull surface and the signs remain deliberate.
intent.unique_topology: Two irrationally related XYZ satin planes form a broad material field; fixture roles reinterpret that field as folds, contour ripple, six-head pearls, discrete organ pulses, and sign engraving.
intent.distance_silhouette: Raw LED strands hold a continuous high white contour with restrained movement even when the Hull material enters a trough.
intent.close_detail: Jewelry facets, Hull satin grain, Silhouette contour, Organ breath, and complete folded 74-pixel sign engraving remain independently authored at close range.
intent.motion_grammar: Two signed long-wrap phase accumulators drift at a golden ratio; direction remains manually dominant and live controls slew without teleporting geometry.
intent.xyz_use: Centered X/Y/Z jointly determine the two material planes. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Broad satin-white material with a quiet longitudinal fold catch.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Protected far-field contour with only a restrained material ripple.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Hero six-pearl white sequence with the strongest native-white catchlight.
fixture_roles.Organs: Discrete structural punctuation, intensified by kick rather than flattened into wash.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel engraved satin nameplate from signIndex=index%74, with an authored full-surface floor and slow fold detail.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel engraved satin nameplate from signIndex=index%74, with an authored full-surface floor and slow fold detail.
intent.jewelry_white: Vintage rails are the native-white hero: an RGB white bed supports six-head pearl catchlights, with sliderWhiteKick reserved for the pearl cores.
intent.palette_white_material: No colorPalette exports. Warm-neutral RGB is shaped only by sliderWarmth; explicit W=A on every pixel and U=0 make the look immune to global palette tinting.

intent.close_detail: High-power Jewelry diamonds, crystalline Hull grain, fixture-cohort Organ stars, and fine sign frost create multiple scales of detail.

intent.why_exists: It is the white family's reverent slow look: warm, calm, readable, and intentionally incapable of becoming a party cue at its defaults.

intent.distance_silhouette: A steady warm contour with a very shallow lift preserves the whole ship throughout the slow dust cycle.
intent.close_detail: Six-head candle flames, height-biased Organ vigils, fine Hull dust rays, and subtle complete folded 74-pixel warm-plaque variation create a ceremonial close read.
intent.motion_grammar: Very slow signed candle material and a broad asymmetric procession fold reverse together through large wraps; all controls slew and no pulse snaps or strobes.
intent.xyz_use: Centered X/Y/Z define candle wells, layered flame/wax material, and the broad procession fold; pixelLocalIndex authors Jewelry candles, while fixtureId phases Organ vigils.
